title: Designprinzipien / Icons
slide_intent: Balance simplicity, consistency and familiar meaning so symbols can be understood quickly.
strategic_value: Shared construction and learned metaphors can make DB controls predictable.
demonstration: Three cards pair a person, directional symbol and checked circle with Einfach, Konsistent and Verlässlich.
practical_value: Evaluate whether an icon contains only necessary detail, fits the family and uses a learned metaphor.

content_islands.name: Principle cards
content_islands.spec: Arrange three icon specimens above their named principles and short explanations.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects minimal detail to recognition and established metaphors to immediate understanding.
reference_purposes.Application: The three principles provide explicit evaluation criteria.
